ROLE: Generate a completely NEW individual Settings icon for Battle Cities, matching the polished chunky 3D blue/gold/silver illustrations in its new Quarters and Socials sets. Do not crop, upscale or copy pixels from screenshot icons.

Near-frontal view with very mild three-quarter depth. Not pixel art, not flat generic vector, not photorealistic product photograph. Few details, clear at128px.
OUTPUT: one isolated COMPLETE object/symbol on genuine transparent alpha background,1024x1024 square, centered with roughly12% clear margin on every side. No clipping, no floor, no cast ground shadow, no haze/halo, no reflection, no scene, no background fill inside negative spaces. No card frame, caption, label, text, digits, logo wordmark, watermark, QR code or UI screenshot. Preserve transparency through internal gaps. Only the inherent control symbols requested below are permitted.
SUBJECT: a chunky glossy BLUE LOUDSPEAKER / speaker horn, oriented horizontally with its flared opening on the right, slight three-quarter view into the dark navy cone. Silver beveled lip, cobalt blue housing and short compact rear housing on left. A large raised GOLD X mute symbol floats immediately over/right of the horn opening, visually attached into one clear cohesive symbol. The X is a simple equal-arm mute cross, not a platform logo. Match the icon in the MUTE row of reference. No sound-wave arcs, no cable, no stand, no extra button.

Keep the same smooth surface and subtle vertical lighting gradient.
This is the source skin for a Unity nine-sliced LOGOUT button; do not bake any lettering into it. No LOGOUT word, no icon, no screws or bolts, no decorative frame added, no new symbols, no texture wear or scratches. The center must remain an uninterrupted plain red fill suitable for stretching. No background, drop shadow, fog or glow beyond the actual button outline. No enlarged transparent canvas or giant margins. Transparent PNG asset, not a screenshot.
